blocks.text: 4月3日台湾发生里氏7.2级地震，台积电厂区测到的最大烈度为5级。文本把地震发生地标注为会后更正的台湾。C.C. Wei（CEO）说这是台湾近25年来最大的地震，各厂仍在3天内恢复全面运营，并感谢客户理解，丢失的产出会在第二季补。Wendell（CFO）说安全机制立刻启动，人员都安全；凭既有的地震应对和演练，机台在头10小时恢复超过七成，第三天全部恢复。没有停电，厂房没有结构损坏，包括全部EUV光刻机在内的关键机台没有损坏。

仍有一部分在制晶圆必须报废。Wendell（CFO）说大部分损失的产出会在第二季补回来，因此对第二季营收的影响很小，毛利压力主要来自报废和材料损失。成本端另一件外部变化是电价。去年4月1日台湾电价已上调17%，今年4月1日起台积电在台湾的电价再上调25%。他预期更高电价还会间接推高材料、化学品、气体和其他可变成本，而且这种影响会延续到下半年。宏观上，C.C. Wei（CEO）说地缘政治和宏观经济的不确定性还在，可能继续压制消费意愿和终端需求，所以内存以外的半导体复苏被他看成温和、渐进，而不是陡峭反转。

指标表第一季营收188.70亿美元，同比增12.9%，环比降3.8%。Wendell（CFO）把环比下降的原因放在智能手机季节性，持续的HPC需求只是部分抵消；新台币营收环比降5.3%。平台上，HPC环比增3%，占营收46%；智能手机降16%，占38%；物联网增5%，占6%；汽车持平，占6%；DCE增33%，占2%。制程上，3纳米占晶圆收入9%，5纳米37%，7纳米19%，7纳米及以下合计65%。C.C. Wei（CEO）说第一季美元营收略高于当季指引，口述为189亿美元，摘要仍用指标表。

问答里，C.C. Wei（CEO）把终端拆开：智能手机是渐进复苏而不是陡峭复苏，PC已经触底但恢复更慢，AI相关数据中心需求非常强，传统服务器不温不火，物联网和消费仍疲弱，汽车库存还在修正。Wendell（CFO）补充，三个月前还预计汽车平台今年增长，现在改为下降，这是预测里真正转向的一块。对台积电，超大规模客户的预算从传统服务器转到AI服务器是有利的，因为公司能拿到AI服务器里GPU、ASIC和网络处理器等大部分半导体含量，而在只靠CPU的传统服务器里份额较低。

行业上，C.C. Wei（CEO）把2024年内存以外的半导体市场同比下调到大约增长10%，晶圆代工行业改为中到高十几的增长，两者都是从2023年很深的库存修正和低基数走出来。公司自己仍把2024年看成健康增长的一年，业务会逐季增长。服务器AI处理器被他窄定义为做训练和推理的GPU、AI加速器和CPU，不含网络、边缘或端侧AI；这块收入今年将超过翻倍，占全年营收低十几的比例，未来五年复合增速50%，到2028年高于营收的20%，并成为HPC平台和未来几年增量收入里最大的贡献。端侧AI方面，他看到神经处理器让裸片变大，手机和PC的换机周期以后会加快，但现在还没发生。

供给最紧的是先进封装。C.C. Wei（CEO）说CoWoS需求非常强，今年产能大概比去年增加一倍以上，但仍然不够，所以同时用封测伙伴的产能来补台积电自己的产出。他的优先顺序是让客户成功，长期伙伴因为工艺更熟，爬坡更容易；让出份额不是考虑。今年大概仍支持不到位，明年会非常努力。3DIC已经有客户开始采用，量还不大，预计从今年起增长。高性能计算客户最先用SoIC或3DIC，智能手机什么时候用，他不愿给时间表。

晶圆产能的调配不是每个节点都能做。C.C. Wei（CEO）解释，一部分5纳米工具转去支持3纳米，是因为两座厂相邻、连通，物理上做得到，用来接多年强需求。7纳米他不准备转成5纳米，因为预期未来几年7纳米需求会重新起来，路径可能类似28纳米，今天没有扎实的转换计划。存货天数增加5天到90天，Wendell（CFO）归因于3纳米爬坡，而不是需求转弱；应收账款周转天数仍是31天。地震造成的报废主要落在第二季的毛利，产出损失大部分会在当季补回。

N3达到公司平均毛利率的时间比N5、N7更长。Wendell（CFO）说以前大约8到10个季度，N3大约要10到12个季度，原因包括工艺更复杂、公司平均毛利率本身抬高，以及N3价格在量产前几年就定了，后来遇到成本通胀。N2到目前为止成本和价值销售做得更好，毛利率形态预期优于N3。2纳米头两年的新流片数量预计多于3纳米和5纳米各自的头两年。量产仍按2025年、爬坡形态类似N3；因为周期时间和后段工序，有意义的收入要到2026年第一季末或第二季初。

Brett Simpson担心成熟制程会因为美国和中国的新厂而出现结构性过剩，并指出12纳米及以上合计只占销售大约三成五、同比仍明显偏弱。C.C. Wei（CEO）承认成熟节点需求仍然疲弱，因为整个半导体只是在慢慢恢复，下半年才预期逐步改善。公司的做法不是去跟通用成熟产能比扩产，而是和战略客户一起做特种工艺，形成有差异、能留存的价值，因此自认对可能的过剩环境暴露较低，成熟节点的利用率和盈利能力可以被保住。

海外制造的成本上升被C.C. Wei（CEO）看成全行业的事，台积电、客户和竞争对手都会更高。公司要靠三件事把差距收窄：用价格反映地域弹性的价值，争取政府支持，再用没有其他厂商能比的技术领先和大制造基地。他的竞争结论是，就算计入海外厂的更高成本，台积电仍会是所在地区效率更高、成本也更有优势的制造商。先进制程这边，AI加速器今天大多还在5纳米或4纳米，客户已经在为3纳米和2纳米做准备，因为数据中心必须算能耗。Wendell（CFO）认为N2会是比N3、N5更大、更长久的节点，美元价值也会更大。

industry_outlook.title: 商业模式（定价与股东回报）

blocks.text: 定价被管理层说成持续的过程，而不是一次性公布涨幅。C.C. Wei（CEO）对Brett Simpson说，公司一直想卖掉自己的价值，客户好，台积电才会好，但这件事还在做。他没有回答AI芯片以后会不会单独涨价，也没有说现在是否已经拿到AI价值链里应有的一份。对Charlie Chan，他把话说得更具体：海外厂、通胀和电价带来更高成本，期望客户分担一部分，而且已经开始谈；如果客户指定要在某个地区生产，增量成本就由双方一起承担。地理弹性被放进要销售的价值里。他拒绝给出百分比，也没有确认外界按出货回推的历史涨幅。

股东回报上，Wendell（CFO）说股利政策原则上是把一年的自由现金流七成用来发现金股利，所以不能拿单季自由现金流来判断。过去几年的基调是可持续，现在重投资进入收获期，政策会改成稳步提高。他没有承诺下一季的股利金额，电话会也没有报出自由现金流数字，指标表同样未单列。利润率的长期锚，是在剔除汇率、并考虑全球制造布局之后，毛利率做到53%及以上；C.C. Wei（CEO）同时把高于25%的可持续股东权益报酬率说成对股东的承诺。下半年会靠内部成本改善和继续销售价值来管利润率。

C.C. Wei（CEO）说，在HPC和AI需求很强的时候，扩大全球制造是为了继续支持美国客户、增加客户信任，也扩大未来的增长空间。亚利桑那计划三座厂，每座洁净室大约是典型逻辑厂的两倍，用来形成规模。第一座厂4月已用N4进入工程晶圆，量产对准2025年上半年。第二座厂在原先公布的3纳米之外升级到2纳米，以对应AI需求，上梁已经完成，量产排在2028年。第三座厂用2纳米或更先进技术，十年末开始生产。他有信心量产后，亚利桑那的质量和可靠性可以做到和台湾一样。

日本熊本第一座特种厂用12/16纳米和22/28纳米，今年第四季量产。和第二座合资厂覆盖40纳米、12/16纳米和6/7纳米，服务消费、汽车、工业和HPC，今年下半年开工，生产目标在2027年底。欧洲德累斯顿的特种厂聚焦汽车和工业，今年第四季开工。海外决策看客户需求以及必要的政府支持，用来为股东争取价值。N2采用纳米片晶体管，在密度和能效上都是业界最先进的技术，器件性能和良率按计划或超前，2025年量产，爬坡类似N3，衍生工艺会继续延长技术领先。先进封装在美国是否由台积电自建，他没有答应，只说后段做在哪里是客户的决定，并欢迎安靠在亚利桑那厂附近建厂，公司会配合支持当地客户。

items.question_summary: 内存以外的半导体和晶圆代工增速被下调之后，需求放缓主要出在哪。智能手机相对三个月前怎样，传统数据中心有没有回来，还是增量仍集中在AI。

items.answer_quote: Yes, smartphone end-market demand is seeing gradual recovery and not a steep recovery, of course. PC has been bottomed out and the recovery is slower. However, AI-related data center demand is very, very strong. And the traditional server demand is slow, lukewarm. IoT and consumer remain sluggish. Automotive inventory continue to correct, okay? What does that mean to TSMC? The budget for a hyperscale player, their wallet share shifted from traditional server to AI server is favorable for TSMC. And we are able to capture most of the semiconductor content in an AI server's area as we define the GPU, ASIC, networking processor, et cetera. Well, we have a lower presence in those CPU-only, CPU-centric traditional server. So we expect our growth will be very healthy.

items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：N3达到公司平均毛利率的时间确实比N5、N7更长。以前N5、N7大约8到10个季度，N3预计大约10到12个季度。原因是工艺更复杂，公司平均毛利率在这期间也提高了，而且N3价格在量产前几年就定下，随后几年成本通胀很大。N2到目前为止成本和价值销售做得更好，毛利率形态预期好于N3。

items.answer_quote: Yes, Gokul, it is true that N3 is taking longer time to reach the corporate margin than the other nodes like N5 or N7. N5 or N7 before, it was like 8 to 10 quarters to reach the corporate. But for N3, we think it will take about 10 to 12 quarters. And this is probably because N3 process complexity has increased, and also our corporate average gross margin also increased during the period. But another reason is that we set the pricing of N3 very early, several years ahead of production. However, we experienced a lot of cost inflation pressures in the following years. So as a result, N3 will take a longer time than N5 and N7 to reach the corporate average gross margin. For N2, based on what we can see so far is that we are doing a better job in cost and selling our value, and we expect N2 to have a better margin profile than N3.

items.question_summary: AI客户和HBM都赚到很高的回报。台积电是否认为自己拿到了AI价值链里应有的一份，以后有没有空间对AI芯片提价。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：公司一直说要卖掉自己的价值，但这是持续的过程，现在正在做。客户做得好，台积电才会好。他把回答收成还在努力，希望能卖掉价值。
items.evasion_note: 没有回答现在是否拿到了AI价值链里应有的回报，也没有说以后会不会对AI芯片提价。
items.answer_quote: We always say that we want to sell our value, but it is a continuous process for TSMC. And let me tell you that we are working on it. We are happy that our customers are doing well. And if customers do well, TSMC does well. So let me summarize it. We are working on it, and we hopefully that we can sell our value.

items.question_summary: 12纳米及以上的成熟节点今年需求仍弱，只占销售大约三成五。下半年能否恢复。美国和中国继续建成熟产能，会不会造成结构性过剩。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：成熟节点需求仍然疲弱，因为半导体行业只是在慢慢恢复，速度不够快，所以预期2024年下半年逐步改善。对其他公司继续大建成熟产能、可能过剩这件事，台积电的策略是和战略客户一起做特种工艺，形成有差异、能留存的价值，因此暴露较低，并相信成熟节点的利用率和盈利能力可以被保住。

new_numbers.meaning: 成熟节点需求的方向，没有给增速

items.answer_quote: First, the mature node demand remains sluggish because as we just announced it, the whole semiconductor industry is gradually recovering, but not fast enough. So we expect to gradually improve in the second half of 2024. As you mentioned that you -- do we have a concern on the overcapacity because of some of the companies, they continue to build a lot of mature node capacity. For us, actually, our strategy at a mature node is work closely with our strategic customers to develop specialty technology solution to meet their requirement. And we create differentiated and long-lasting value to customers. So we are less exposed to this possible overcapacity environment. And we believe that our utilization and profitability on mature node can be well protected.

items.question_summary: N2爬坡类似3纳米，有意义的收入什么时候出现，会不会提前。头两年流片更多，会不会因此比前代节点更陡、更大。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：N2爬坡形态和N3很像。量产从2025年下半年开始，实际上是2025年最后一个季度；加上周期时间和后段工序，有意义的收入从2026年第一季末或第二季初开始。流片多、客户接触早，是因为N2很复杂，客户准备时间更长，放量仍看各自的产品路线和生意考虑。即便如此，N2仍会是台积电非常大的节点。

new_numbers.meaning: N2有意义收入开始的时间

items.answer_quote: Randy, the N2's ramp profile we say is very similar to N3 because of, look at the cycle time, we start the N2 production in the second half of 2025, actually in the last quarter of 2025. And because of the cycle time and all the kind of back-end process, and so we expect the meaningful revenue will start from the end of the first quarter or beginning of the second quarter of 2026. That's what we mean that is the profile is very similar to N3. Now your second question is there have been a lot of engagement and the tape-out will be higher, and do we see a very steep kind of production? Well, we do expect that, but let me say again, N2 is a very complicated work or a very complex technology node. So my customer, they also take a little bit longer time to prepare for the tape-out. So that's why they all engage with TSMC in the early stage. And -- but for their product ramp-up, they will have their own product road map and their own business consideration. However, we still say that N2 will be a very, very big node for TSMC.

items.question_summary: AI加速器预期上修之后，资本开支绝对额会不会至少随营收增长，资本密集度会不会升到中三十几以上。今年算不算3纳米开支高峰之后的消化年。
items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：更高的资本开支总是对应后面年份更高的增长机会，产能按长期结构性需求来排，会和客户一起为AI准备合适的产能。过去几年资本密集度高，现在资本开支的增幅正在趋平，今年和往后几年大约在中三十几；未来若有机会就再投资。他不把今年称为消化年，每年都是按向前看的机会来投。

new_numbers.meaning: 今年和往后几年的资本密集度，不是资本开支金额

items.evasion_note: 没有确认资本开支绝对额会随营收增长，也没有说资本密集度会升到中三十几以上。
items.answer_quote: The capital intensity, in the past few years, it was high as we invested heavily to meet the strong customer demand. Now the increase -- the rate of increase for the CapEx is leveling off. So this year and the next several years, we are expecting that the capital intensity is somewhere at the mid-30s level. But as I just said, if there are opportunities in the future years, then we will invest accordingly.

items.question_summary: 美国厂和电价都在推高成本。能不能给一个涨价区间。分析师自己回推2022年约涨10%、2023年约涨5%，问2025年会不会按类似幅度涨，以支撑53%的毛利率。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：定价策略很机密，完全是公司和客户之间的事。他愿意多说的是，海外、近期通胀和电价确实带来更高成本，期望客户分担一部分，而且已经开始谈。海外厂要分享的价值也包括地理位置的弹性；客户如果指定某个地区，增量成本就要一起分担。
items.evasion_note: 说明了客户分担更高成本，但没有给出2025年涨价幅度，也没有确认分析师回推的2022年约10%和2023年约5%。
items.answer_quote: First, I would like to emphasize again this kind of a pricing strategy is very confidential and totally between TSMC and the customer. However, let me expand a little bit, we do encounter some kind of higher cost in the overseas or even recently, the inflation and the electricity. We expect our customers to share some of the higher cost with us, and we already started our discussion with our customers. And as I said, for the overseas fab, we want to share our value, which also includes the flexibility of geographic location or something like that. If my customer requests to be in some certain area, then definitely, TSMC and the customer had to share the incremental cost.

items.question_summary: CoWoS很紧。怎么在大客户和较小的ASIC、GPU客户之间分配。主要客户明年要两倍产能、若供不上，能不能接受份额给到竞争对手。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：需求非常强，已经尽全力扩产，今年产能大概比去年增加一倍以上，但还是不够，所以用封测伙伴补台积电的产能。第一优先是让客户成功，不管哪一家；长期伙伴在技术和工艺上合作更深，爬坡更容易。今年大概仍不够，明年会非常努力。让出市场份额不是他的考虑。

new_numbers.number: 今年产能大概比去年增加一倍以上
new_numbers.meaning: CoWoS产能，而且他接着说仍然不够

items.evasion_note: 没有给出大客户和小客户的分配比例，也没有说主要客户明年两倍的需求能不能被满足。

It's probably more than double this year as compared with last year. However, it's still not enough to meet the customers' demand, and we leverage our OSAT partners to complement of TSMC's capacity to fulfill our customers' need. Still not enough, of course. But in my mind, my first priority is to make our customer to be successful, no matter which one. And of course, the long-term partners will have a better cooperation with TSMC in terms of technology and process complexity, so much easier to be ramped up. However, no matter what, let me say again, the demand is very high, extremely high. And we do our best to increase the capacity to alleviate the shortage. We also leverage the OSAT partners. We want to make sure that all our customers get supported, probably not enough this year; but for next year, we try, we try very hard. And you mentioned about giving up some market share, that's not my consideration. My consideration is to help our customers to be successful in their market.

items.question_summary: AI加速器现在大多还在5纳米，落后手机一个节点。什么时候追上，会不会在2纳米成为技术驱动。若手机和HPC一起上，2纳米头两年的收入会不会比过去更大。
items.answer_summary:
C.C. Wei（CEO）：今天的AI加速器大多在5纳米或4纳米。客户已经在和下一个节点、甚至再下一个节点合作，因为数据中心必须考虑功耗。3纳米比5纳米更省能，2纳米还会再改善，客户的方向是从4纳米走到3纳米、再到2纳米。
Wendell（CFO）：先进技术会是更长久、也更大的节点，N2大于N3或N5，美元价值一定会更大。

new_numbers.meaning: 他确认的目前AI加速器主要制程

items.answer_quote: Today, all the AI accelerators, most of them are in the 5- or 4-nanometer technology. But my customers are working with TSMC for the next node. Even for the next, next node, they have to move fast because, as I said, the power consumption has to be considered in the AI data center. So the energy-efficient is fairly important. So our 3-nanometer is much better than the 5-nanometer. And again, it will be improved in the 2-nanometer. So all I can say is all my customers are working on this kind of a trend from 4-nanometer to 3 to 2.

items.question_summary: 第一季自由现金流看起来很强，资本密集度开始稳定，又在付很高的未分配盈余税。股利能否更积极，往后几季会不会提高。分析师自己估算当前股利远低于自由现金流的70%。
items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：股利政策原则上是把一年自由现金流的70%作为现金股利，所以不要只看单季自由现金流来判断。过去几年的重投资现在进入收获，股利政策会从过去的可持续，转成稳步提高。

new_numbers.meaning: 现金股利的原则比例，不是单季比例，也没有自由现金流金额

items.answer_quote: Yes. Bruce, the -- our dividend policy is, in principle, to pay 70% of our free cash flow in a year as cash dividends. So I would not just look at quarterly cash, free cash flow to make a judgment. But indeed, as we said before, now that we're harvesting the heavy investment that we did in the past few years, we expect our dividend policy to switch to steadily increasing from the sustainable in the past few years.

items.question_summary: 手机和PC复苏偏慢，但AI手机、AI PC很热。端侧AI何时放量，对台积电意味着什么。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：端侧AI的第一层影响是裸片变大。放进神经处理器之后裸片会变大，这已经看到了。再往后，手机和这类PC的换机周期至少会加快一点，但现在还没发生，他预期很快会发生。整体上端侧AI对台积电是正面的，因为公司能拿到更大的市场份额。

new_numbers.meaning: 端侧AI对台积电的第一层影响，没有给面积增幅

items.answer_quote: The edge AI or the on-device AI, the first order of magnitude is the die size. We saw without the AI -- with the AI for neural processor inside. The die size will be increased, okay? That's the first we observed. And it's happening. And then for the future, I would think that replacement cycle for smartphone or for those kind of a PC will be accelerated a little bit in the future, at least. It's not happening yet, but we do expect that it will happen soon. And all in all, I would say that on-device AI will be very positive for TSMC because we capture the larger share of the market.

Wendell（CFO）：跟上一次的说法，今年3纳米收入将超过2023年的三倍。

new_numbers.meaning: 3纳米收入相对2023年，不是下半年占比

items.evasion_note: 没有确认下半年3纳米收入占比达到20%以上，也没有给2025年的占比。

items.question_summary: 已经在把部分5纳米产能转去支持3纳米。7纳米利用率和收入仍低于高峰，会不会也把7纳米工具转去支持更领先的节点。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：一个节点能转到下一个节点，是因为有物理条件。3纳米和5纳米的厂相邻而且连通，所以5纳米转到3纳米比较容易，不是每个节点都能这样做。7纳米转到5纳米，他没有这个计划，因为预期未来几年7纳米需求会再起来，路径可能重复28纳米的经验。今天没有把N7转成N5的扎实计划。
items.answer_quote: We can convert one technology node capacity to the next one is because of our there's physical advantage, meaning, let me give you one example, our 3-nanometer and 5-nanometer are adjacent to each other, the fabs, and they are all connected. No, because we expect the N7 in the next couple of years, it will pick up, the demand will pick up again. And it will repeat -- probably repeat the same kind of experience we have in 28-nanometer. So today, no, we don't have any solid plan to convert the N7 into N5.

items.evasion_note: 没有给智能手机采用SoIC的时间表，只说高性能计算最先用，其他领域要再观察。
items.answer_quote: Just HPC product is the first one. HPC customer is the first one to adopt, that is a 3DIC or SoIC's advanced packaging technology. And the other area, let's wait, wait and see. I cannot make any comment. We are working on it.

C.C. Wei（CEO）：裸片变大已经观察到。换机周期加快会发生，但2025年现在太早，给不出确定数字。趋势向上，预期生意会不错。
Wendell（CFO）：跟上一次的说法，今年3纳米收入将超过2023年的三倍。

evasive_list.answer_quote: it will happen, but I cannot give you a definite number because of -- it's too early to predict in 2025. But it's an upward trend, no doubt about it, and we expect we have a good business.

evasive_list.question_summary: SoIC被更广泛采用之后，智能手机客户有没有开始感兴趣。智能手机采用SoIC大概是什么时间。
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：先采用3DIC或SoIC先进封装的是高性能计算客户。其他领域再看，他不能评论，还在做。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有给智能手机采用SoIC的时间表，只说高性能计算最先用，其他领域要再观察。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Just HPC product is the first one. HPC customer is the first one to adopt, that is a 3DIC or SoIC's advanced packaging technology. And the other area, let's wait, wait and see. I cannot make any comment. We are working on it.

evasive_list.question_summary: 美国、尤其是2纳米的投资，包不包括先进封装。先进封装会不会仍主要集中在台湾。
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：后段服务做在哪里，一直是客户的决定。亚利桑那这边，他乐见安靠宣布在离台积电亚利桑那厂很近的地方建先进封装厂，公司正在和安靠合作，支持当地客户的需求。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有说台积电自己会不会在亚利桑那建先进封装，只说后段地点由客户决定，并提到安靠的邻近厂。
evasive_list.answer_quote: It is always customer's decision for where the back-end service are done for their product. So in Arizona, we are happy to see that Amkor's recent announcement to build an advanced packaging facility that's very close to our AZ fab. Actually, we are working with Amkor and try to support all our customers in AZ and for their demand, for their need.
